home.title: Wavebuto
home.intro: Wavebuto is a small site with a small job: say what it is, and give you one way to get in touch. There is nothing here to sign up for and nothing to dismiss.
home.outro: If you have a question, send it through the form further down. We read what arrives and reply by email. That is the whole of it.

images.dawn: Abstract placeholder: a pale sky over three blue wave bands.
images.noon: Abstract placeholder: a single deep-blue wave crest on a light background.
images.dusk: Abstract placeholder: dark water under a muted grey sky with a thin light horizon.

contact.title: Get in touch

errors.name: Enter your name (2–80 characters).
errors.email: Enter a valid email address, like ada@example.com.
errors.subject: Choose what this is about.

contact.notice: We'll use your message to reply to you. We don't store it for anything else.
contact.success: Thanks — we'll get back to you.
contact.failure: That didn't send. Try again, or email us at hello@wavebuto.example.
